thread:
Mira: GA: Hosted OpenAPI Streams + Edge-Lite tool-calling are GA as of today. Rolling to prod in phases — big thanks to eng + runtime team :tada:
Devin: Nice! what's the migration path for existing streaming endpoints? any breaking changes?
Mira: Phase 1: all newly created projects default to OpenAPI Streams. Phase 2 (2 weeks): we will provide alias mappings and an opt-in migration tool for existing endpoints. No forced switch.
Devin: ok good. and dedicated/private customers?
Mira: Dedicated gets a control-plane toggle. Private customers will get a patch that adds the toggle next week; account team will reach out for activation.
Sam: Docs + SDKs updated and pushed to staging. Example curl for streaming (SSE):
```
curl -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/openapi/streams" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-edge-lite","input":"hello"}'
```
Sam: Note: tool-calling in streams requires the `X-Redwood-Tool-Call: true` header and the `tools` object in the OpenAPI payload.
Anna: Migration guide + changelog live: https://redwood.ai/docs/openapi-streams/migration. Added a short section on multipart streaming vs SSE.
Devin: any perf expectations? p95/p50?
ops-oncall: deploy-bot: canary deployed to us-east-1 at 2007502520. Early numbers: p50 ~ 55ms, p95 ~ 180ms on typical traces. No errors > 0.5% so far. Monitoring for 1h.
deploy-bot: release/edge-openapi-streams@prod tag 1.0.0-ga deployed to 3 nodes in us-east-1.
Sam: small compatibility note: default encoder quantization changed for edge-lite; if teams compiled custom kernels you might see small deltas. Filed dev note in docs.
Natalie: Marketing prepping blog + changelog; we'll avoid SLA promises in the first post. Planning announcement at 12:30pm PT — please flag any last-minute customer blockers.
Mira: @Devin @Anna please triage any docs or quickstart fixes stat. We'll send customer email at noon PT. :mailbox_with_mail: 
Devin: watching metrics and logged dashboards + alerts. I'll open an incidents thread if anything spikes.
Anna: updated quickstart with Postman collection and the new SDK snippet.
Mira: Quick post-launch checklist: confirm alarms, update SDK release notes, ensure support rotation aware, and collect initial perf telemetry for Optimize. Thanks all :rocket:
